title: Wallhaven Client Album Export
description: Portable JSON document produced by the album export action and accepted by the album import action. Contains the album name and the wallhaven identifiers of all member wallpapers.

version.description: Export format version. Import rejects unknown or unsupported versions.

name.description: Album name. MUST NOT be empty or whitespace-only after trimming.

wallpapers.description: Ordered list of wallhaven image identifiers that make up the album.
